report:
case: infeasible-transport
      SYNTHETIC. No real donor data; every duration is illustrative and none is a clinical or regulatory claim — the cold-ischemia figure in particular is a placeholder, not a tolerance. Adapted from REGISTRAR's fixtures/cases/infeasible-transport.json (MIT). A case that cannot be met, where no single constraint is unreasonable: cross-clamp is pinned, the transport leg plus the receiving centre's preparation do not fit inside the budget. The closure detects a negative cycle; a flat timer list detects nothing, because no timer has expired.

INFEASIBLE — this plan cannot be met.
  cross_clamp -> implant -> arrival -> organ_out -> cross_clamp
  these constraints cannot all hold —
    implant - cross_clamp <= 480  [L1]  ISCHEMIA BUDGET — ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDER, NOT A TOLERANCE running +480m
    arrival - implant <= -150  [L3]  accepting-centre preparation to incision running +330m
    organ_out - arrival <= -300  [L3]  transport, door to door     running +30m
    cross_clamp - organ_out <= -60  [L1]  recovery to packaged     running -30m
